svg.aria-label: Four endpoints with the share of traffic each one receives. Loading the feed and opening a single post are reads and happen on essentially every loop. Liking a post is a write and happens on fifteen per cent of loops. Creating a post is a write and happens on two per cent. Bars show the proportions. The arithmetic underneath: about 2.17 requests per loop, of which roughly 92 per cent are reads and 8 per cent are writes. The caption explains that a read-dominated mix is what makes caching the right lever, and that the same experiment on a write-heavy application would reach a different conclusion, so the traffic mix has to be measured before a fix is chosen.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: FOUR ENDPOINTS, AND THE MIX IS THE WHOLE STORY
